name: Docker
certifications: KCNA: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (next step)

beginner.summary: No container experience assumed. Participants learn to run, build, network, store data for and compose containers, ending with a containerised three-tier application.
prerequisites: Basic Linux or Windows command line
Has run or written a simple web application
Laptop able to run Docker Desktop or Docker Engine
outcomes: Explain containers, images and how they differ from virtual machines
Build efficient images with Dockerfiles and publish them to a registry
Connect containers with networks and keep data with volumes
Run multi-container applications with Docker Compose

days.topic: Containers versus Virtual Machines and Docker Setup
subtopics: Linux namespaces and cgroups in plain terms
docker run, ps, stop and rm
days.lab_task: Install Docker, run an nginx container on port 8080, view its logs, open a shell inside it, and clean up all containers and images afterwards.
days.deliverable: Command transcript with the web page screenshot and a short note on containers versus VMs
checks: Ask: why does a container start faster than a VM?
Participant explains shared kernel and no guest OS boot
objectives: Explain how containers differ from virtual machines

subtopics: Image layers and the union filesystem
Image size and why it matters
days.lab_task: Pull three versions of the python image, compare their sizes and layers, tag one, and push it to your Docker Hub account.
days.deliverable: Size comparison table, layer history output and the pushed image URL
checks: Pull the pushed image on another machine or after deleting it locally
Slim image is smaller, with sizes recorded
Same image ID as the tag
objectives: Explain image layers, tags and digests

days.lab_task: Write a Dockerfile for a small Python or Node.js web app, add a .dockerignore, and reorder instructions so a code change does not reinstall dependencies.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, .dockerignore and two build logs showing cache use
checks: Change one line of app code and rebuild
Dependency install step uses the cache
Check the image for the .git folder

subtopics: Connecting a container to several networks
Network troubleshooting with curl and ping
days.lab_task: Create two user-defined networks, run a web container on both, a database only on the backend network, and prove the database is not reachable from the frontend network.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, commands and connectivity test results
checks: From the web container, reach the database by name
From a frontend-only container, reach the database
Name does not resolve or connection fails
Lists the web and database containers

subtopics: Choosing between volumes and bind mounts
days.lab_task: Run PostgreSQL with a named volume, add data, delete and recreate the container, then back up the volume to a tar file and restore it into a new volume.
days.deliverable: Commands, query results before and after, and the backup file
checks: Recreate the database container with the same volume
Restore the backup into a new volume
Restored database has the same rows
Run the database without a volume and recreate it
Data is lost, and the participant explains why

subtopics: docker compose up, down, logs and ps
days.lab_task: Write a compose file for a web app, API and PostgreSQL with health checks, a named volume and an .env file, and bring the whole stack up with one command.
days.deliverable: compose.yaml, .env.example and a screenshot of the running app
checks: All services healthy and the app works
Start the stack with the database slow to start
API waits for the database health check
Run docker compose down and up again

days.topic: Runtime Configuration and Secrets for Containers
subtopics: ENV in images versus runtime variables
days.lab_task: Make the API read its database URL and log level from the environment, provide the password as a Compose secret, and prove no secret is baked into the image.
days.deliverable: Updated app, compose file and image history check
checks: App logs at the new level without rebuilding
Run docker history on the image
No password appears in any layer
Read the secret inside the container

subtopics: Why image size and attack surface matter
Slim, Alpine and distroless base images
Removing build tools from runtime images
days.lab_task: Convert a Java or Go application Dockerfile to a multi-stage build with a distroless runtime image, and compare size and vulnerability count with the original.
days.deliverable: Both Dockerfiles and a comparison table of size and vulnerabilities
checks: Multi-stage image is much smaller, with figures recorded
Look for compilers in the runtime image
objectives: Build small images with multi-stage builds

days.lab_task: Scan the app image with Trivy, fix all critical findings, run the container as non-root with a read-only filesystem and dropped capabilities, and rescan.
days.deliverable: Before and after scan reports and the hardened run command or compose settings
checks: Try to write to / inside the container

subtopics: docker inspect for state and configuration
days.lab_task: Fix five broken containers prepared by the trainer (wrong command, port conflict, missing variable, volume permissions, memory limit) and record cause, evidence and fix.
days.deliverable: Troubleshooting log for all five faults
checks: Fix all five within the time limit
Read the log entry for the memory fault
Exit code 137 and OOMKilled are recorded as evidence

days.topic: Resource Limits and Container Health Checks
subtopics: What happens when a health check fails
days.lab_task: Add memory and CPU limits, a health check and a restart policy to the API, then make it unhealthy and show the restart behaviour and log rotation.
days.deliverable: Updated compose file and evidence of limits, health status and restarts
checks: Container is killed and restarted by its policy
Log files rotate at the configured size
objectives: Add health checks and restart policies

subtopics: Cloud registries: ECR, ACR, GCR and Artifact Registry
days.lab_task: Run a private registry with authentication, push versioned images using semantic version and Git SHA tags, and deploy a specific version by digest.
days.deliverable: Registry setup, tagging scheme and deployment by digest
checks: Shows semantic version and SHA tags
Deploy by digest after retagging latest

days.lab_task: Containerise a provided legacy web application that writes logs to files and stores uploads locally, fixing logging, state and shutdown so it runs as two replicas.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, compose file and a list of application changes made
checks: Run two replicas and upload a file through one
File is available through the other
It shuts down cleanly within the grace period
Read the application logs with docker logs

days.lab_task: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that builds the image with cache, runs tests in a container, scans it with Trivy, and pushes tagged images only from main.
days.deliverable: Workflow file and two pipeline runs (branch and main)
checks: Image builds and tests run but nothing is pushed
Pipeline fails at the scan step
Image is pushed with the Git SHA tag
objectives: Build and test images in CI
Publish images from the main branch only

subtopics: Bind mounts for live code reload
Debugging an app inside a container
days.lab_task: Set up a dev container and a compose override for live reload, attach a debugger to the API, and run integration tests against a disposable database with Testcontainers.
days.deliverable: Dev container configuration, override file and integration test run
checks: Edit code while the stack runs
Set a breakpoint in the containerised API
Tests start and remove their own database
objectives: Run integration tests with disposable containers

days.lab_task: Add cAdvisor, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki to the compose stack, build a dashboard for CPU, memory and restarts per service, and alert on repeated restarts.
days.deliverable: Monitoring compose file, dashboard JSON and a fired alert
checks: Search logs for an error message
Found in Loki with the container label

days.topic: Docker Swarm and Moving to Orchestration
subtopics: Why a single host is not enough
days.lab_task: Deploy the compose stack to a three-node Swarm with a rolling update, then convert it to Kubernetes manifests and run it on a local cluster.
days.deliverable: Swarm stack file, rolling update log, Kubernetes manifests and a comparison note
checks: Update the API image in Swarm
App runs on Kubernetes after fixing what Kompose missed
objectives: Run services across hosts with Swarm
Move a Compose app to Kubernetes

subtopics: Backing up databases running in containers
Disaster recovery for a single host
days.lab_task: Schedule consistent backups of the PostgreSQL container with restic to object storage, then restore the whole stack on a new host and verify the data.
days.deliverable: Backup scripts, schedule and the restore test record
checks: Database dump taken with the database in a consistent state
Old backups are removed as configured

days.topic: Containerising a Three-Tier Application End to End
days.lab_task: Containerise a React frontend, a Python or Java API and PostgreSQL with secure images, health checks, limits, secrets and a CI pipeline that builds, scans and pushes them.
days.deliverable: Repository with Dockerfiles, compose file, CI workflow and a README
checks: Clone the repository on a clean machine and run docker compose up
Whole app works with no manual steps beyond the README
All images build, pass the scan and are pushed
API reconnects and data is intact
objectives: Apply security, health and configuration practices

days.lab_task: Deliver a containerised application with small secure images, a Compose stack, persistent data with backups, monitoring and a CI pipeline, then demonstrate a failure and recovery.
days.deliverable: Repository, running stack, backup test, dashboard and a 10-minute demo
checks: Kill the API container during the demo
Restart policy brings it back and the app recovers
objectives: Deliver a containerised application end to end
Combine images, networking, storage, security and CI

intermediate.summary: For people who already build and run containers. Covers image engineering, BuildKit, runtime internals, security hardening, supply chain, registries at scale and preparing containers for production orchestration.
prerequisites: Writes Dockerfiles and runs multi-container apps with Compose
Comfortable with Linux, networking basics and Git
outcomes: Engineer fast, reproducible, multi-platform image builds
Explain container runtime internals and debug at that level
Harden images and runtimes and secure the image supply chain
Prepare containerised applications for production orchestration

days.lab_task: Rewrite a slow Dockerfile using cache mounts, a secret mount for a private package token and parallel stages, and measure clean and incremental build times.
days.deliverable: Optimised Dockerfile and a timing table before and after
checks: Optimised build is faster, with timings recorded
Inspect image history for the token
Build twice from a clean cache with the same inputs
objectives: Speed up builds with BuildKit features

days.topic: Multi-Platform Images for ARM and x86
subtopics: Performance on Graviton and ARM laptops
days.lab_task: Publish one image tag that works on amd64 and arm64, using cross-compilation instead of emulation for the build stage, and test it on both platforms.
days.deliverable: Buildx configuration, manifest inspection and test runs on both platforms
checks: Run the tag on an arm64 machine
Compare emulated and cross-compiled build times
objectives: Use cross-compilation to avoid slow emulation

subtopics: Container lifecycle at the runtime level
Inspecting containers with ctr and nsenter
days.lab_task: Run a container directly with runc from an exported filesystem, inspect its namespaces and cgroup limits on the host, and compare it with the same container started by Docker.
days.deliverable: Annotated commands and a diagram of the runtime stack
checks: List namespaces of the runc container
Shows its own PID, network and mount namespaces
Read the memory limit from cgroups
Docker, containerd and runc roles are correct

subtopics: Debugging with tcpdump in network namespaces
days.lab_task: Trace a request from the host port to a container with tcpdump and iptables counters, then attach a container to the LAN with macvlan.
days.deliverable: Annotated packet capture, iptables rules and the macvlan setup
checks: Show the NAT rule for a published port
Rule matches the container IP and port
Capture traffic inside the container namespace
Reach the macvlan container from another LAN machine
Responds on its own LAN IP
objectives: Explain how Docker networking works underneath
Debug traffic at the namespace level
Use macvlan when containers need LAN addresses

days.lab_task: Run Docker Bench, fix the top findings, enable user namespace remapping, and apply a custom seccomp profile that blocks a system call the app does not need.
days.deliverable: Before and after Docker Bench reports and the seccomp profile
checks: Run a blocked system call inside the container
Check the container's root user on the host
Mapped to an unprivileged host UID
objectives: Harden the Docker daemon and host
Restrict containers with seccomp and AppArmor

subtopics: Software bills of materials with Syft
Vulnerability management with Grype or Trivy
days.lab_task: Generate SBOMs, sign images and attach provenance in CI, verify signatures before deployment, and automate base image updates with Renovate.
days.deliverable: CI workflow, SBOMs, signature verification output and a Renovate pull request
checks: Deploy an unsigned image through the deploy script
Release a new base image version

days.lab_task: Deploy Harbor with two projects, enforce scanning and signed-only pulls on production, replicate images to a second registry, and set retention rules.
days.deliverable: Harbor configuration, policy tests and replication evidence
checks: Pull an unsigned image from the production project
Only the configured number of tags remain
objectives: Enforce image policies at the registry

subtopics: Compose in CI for integration tests
days.lab_task: Restructure a 10-service compose setup into base, dev, test and CI files with profiles, run integration tests in CI with it, and use compose watch for local development.
days.deliverable: Compose file set, CI job and a demo of compose watch
checks: Stack starts, tests pass and the stack is removed
Edit code with compose watch running
objectives: Use Compose for repeatable integration tests
Speed up development with compose watch

subtopics: JVM and Python settings inside containers
days.lab_task: Benchmark a Java and a Python service in containers, fix CPU throttling and memory settings, and document the performance gain for each change.
days.deliverable: Benchmark reports and a tuning log with measured effects
checks: Show JVM memory settings respect the container limit
Heap is sized from the limit
Explain one change with no effect

days.topic: Logging and Observability for Containerised Apps
days.lab_task: Ship structured logs with Fluent Bit, add OpenTelemetry tracing across the frontend, API and database calls, and find a slow request from its trace.
days.deliverable: Collector configuration, trace screenshots and a log query
checks: Fluent Bit buffers and delivers logs later

subtopics: Windows container types: process and Hyper-V isolation
Base images: Server Core and Nano Server
days.lab_task: Containerise a provided .NET Framework web app on Windows Server Core, run it with a mounted configuration file, and document the differences from Linux containers.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, running container evidence and a differences note
checks: Open the app in a browser
App responds from the Windows container
Change the mounted configuration and restart
Covers isolation, image size and networking

days.lab_task: Audit the three-tier app against a Kubernetes-readiness checklist, fix every gap, and package it as a Helm chart running on a local cluster.
days.deliverable: Readiness checklist with fixes, Helm chart and running deployment
checks: Send SIGTERM to the API under load
Run the chart with the restricted Pod Security Standard
objectives: Handle shutdown and health endpoints correctly

days.lab_task: Add Hadolint, container structure tests, Testcontainers integration tests and a smoke test to the CI pipeline for the three-tier app.
days.deliverable: Test configuration and a CI run showing each stage
checks: Remove the non-root user from the image
All stages pass within the stated time
objectives: Test images as well as code

days.topic: Serverless Containers: Fargate, Cloud Run and Container Apps
subtopics: What serverless containers manage for you
Networking and secrets on each service
Cost compared with VMs and Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Deploy the same API image to Cloud Run and one other serverless container service, configure scaling and secrets on both, and compare cold start and monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Deployment scripts, cold start measurements and a cost comparison
checks: Cold start times are measured and recorded
Uses the same traffic assumptions for both

days.lab_task: Respond to a simulated compromised container: detect it with Falco, capture its filesystem changes, isolate it, rotate its secrets and rebuild from a trusted image.
days.deliverable: Incident timeline, evidence files and remediation record
checks: Falco alerts on the shell and file write
docker diff lists the attacker's files
Use the old secret after rotation

subtopics: Tracking which services use which base
days.lab_task: Create a golden base image with an automated weekly rebuild, a catalogue of approved images, and a report of which services run outdated bases.
days.deliverable: Base image pipeline, catalogue and image health report
checks: Lists services on outdated bases with age
Deploy an image not in the catalogue
objectives: Manage base images across an organisation

subtopics: Secure boot and device identity overview
days.lab_task: Run a sensor-reading service and a local dashboard on an ARM device or emulator, ship logs to a central server, and roll out an update to three devices in waves.
days.deliverable: Device setup, update process and wave rollout record
checks: Roll out to the first device
Update succeeds before the others are updated
Disconnect a device during the update
Logs from all three devices are present

days.topic: Cost and Resource Efficiency for Container Hosts
days.lab_task: Measure a host running 12 services, right-size their limits from a week of sample data, repack them onto fewer hosts and report the cost per service before and after.
days.deliverable: Utilisation analysis, new limits and a cost report
checks: Compare host count before and after
Fewer hosts with no service over its limit
Run the load test after repacking
Latency stays within the stated target

days.lab_task: Assess 8 provided applications for containerisation, plan two migration waves, containerise two of them, and write cut-over and rollback plans.
days.deliverable: Assessment table, wave plan, two containerised apps and cut-over plans
checks: Each app has a decision and reason
Describes how to return to the old deployment

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Secure Container Platform for a Product Team
days.lab_task: Build a container delivery platform for a product team with multi-platform builds, signed images and SBOMs, registry policies, tests and observability, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline runs, registry configuration, dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Signed multi-platform image with SBOM reaches the registry
Try to run an unsigned image
objectives: Design a secure container delivery platform
Combine builds, supply chain, registry and observability

advanced.summary: For engineers who run containers at scale. Covers runtime and kernel internals, sandboxing, supply chain at organisation scale, build systems, performance engineering and container platform strategy.
prerequisites: Has built and operated containerised services in production
Comfortable with Linux internals, networking and CI/CD
Has used Kubernetes or another orchestrator
outcomes: Debug containers at the kernel, runtime and network level
Design sandboxed and multi-tenant container runtimes
Run organisation-wide image supply chain and build platforms
Set container platform strategy with cost, security and reliability evidence

days.lab_task: Build a working container by hand with unshare, a cgroup and an overlay mount, then observe its system calls with bpftrace.
days.deliverable: Script that builds the container and annotated bpftrace output
checks: Run ps inside the hand-built container
Only its own processes are visible
Process is killed by the kernel
bpftrace shows the calls with counts
objectives: Explain the kernel features containers use

days.topic: Sandboxed Runtimes: gVisor, Kata Containers and Firecracker
subtopics: Why shared-kernel isolation is not enough for some workloads
days.lab_task: Run the same service under runc, gVisor and Kata, benchmark start-up time, throughput and memory, and write a runtime selection policy for untrusted workloads.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results and a runtime selection policy
checks: Start-up, throughput and memory figures are recorded
Run a kernel exploit test case under gVisor
Does not reach the host kernel
Each workload class has a runtime and reason

days.topic: eBPF Networking and Observability for Containers
days.lab_task: Use Hubble to map service traffic, Tetragon to detect a process opening a sensitive file, and continuous profiling to find the hottest function in a service.
days.deliverable: Traffic map, Tetragon event and profiling report
checks: Tetragon reports the process and file
Hottest function identified with share of CPU
objectives: Use eBPF for networking and security insight

subtopics: Incident response for a poisoned dependency
days.lab_task: Design a supply chain programme reaching SLSA level 3 for one service, publish VEX statements for non-exploitable CVEs, and run a tabletop exercise for a poisoned dependency.
days.deliverable: Programme design, provenance evidence, VEX documents and tabletop notes
checks: Build source, builder and inputs are verified
Non-exploitable findings are suppressed with justification
Detection, containment and recovery steps are defined
objectives: Run supply chain security at organisation scale

days.lab_task: Run BuildKit in Kubernetes with a shared remote cache for a monorepo of 10 services, cut total build time by half, and verify two builds are bit-for-bit identical.
days.deliverable: Build platform configuration, timing reports and reproducibility proof
checks: At least 50% faster or the gap is explained
Builds run in ephemeral, isolated builders
objectives: Design build platforms for many services

subtopics: Network performance with SR-IOV and DPDK overview
Image pull performance and lazy loading
days.lab_task: Reduce p99 latency of a latency-sensitive service sharing hosts with batch work, and cut container start-up time with lazy image loading, measuring each change.
days.deliverable: Performance report with measured effect of each change
checks: Run the latency test alongside batch load
p99 within the stated target after changes
Lazy loading reduces start-up time, with figures

days.lab_task: Design and build isolation for three untrusted tenants running customer code, with sandboxed runtimes, network isolation, quotas, separate registries and audit logs.
days.deliverable: Tenancy design, configuration and an isolation test report
checks: Tenant A tries to reach Tenant B's containers
Tenant A runs a CPU-heavy job
Tenant B's latency stays within target
Tenant actions are recorded with identity
objectives: Combine runtime, network and storage isolation

subtopics: Admission policies for the whole organisation
days.lab_task: Set up a container security operations programme: vulnerability SLAs with dashboards, runtime detection alerts sent to a SIEM, and a red team exercise with findings and fixes.
days.deliverable: Programme document, dashboards, SIEM integration and red team report
checks: Alert appears in the SIEM with context
Shows open vulnerabilities by age against SLA
Each finding has a fix and owner
objectives: Run container security as an operational programme
Connect container security to the SOC

days.lab_task: Define platform SLOs, then run chaos tests for a registry outage, a runtime upgrade and a host failure, adding mitigations such as pull-through caches and pre-pulled images.
days.deliverable: Platform SLOs, chaos results and mitigations with before and after evidence
checks: Take the registry down during a deployment
Upgrade the runtime on a node under load
Platform SLOs met during the tests

days.topic: WebAssembly and the Future of Workload Packaging
subtopics: What WebAssembly brings to server workloads
Start-up time and size compared with containers
When to choose Wasm over containers
days.lab_task: Build the same HTTP function as a container and as a WebAssembly component, run both, and compare size, start-up time, throughput and language limits.
days.deliverable: Both implementations and a comparison report with a recommendation
checks: Compare artefact sizes and start-up times
Run the Wasm component through containerd
States when each option fits with reasons

subtopics: IP address management for large fleets
days.lab_task: Replace an overlay network with native routing announced over BGP, add an egress gateway with fixed source IPs, and compare latency and throughput.
days.deliverable: Network design, configuration and a performance comparison
checks: Native routing improves both, with figures
Check egress source IP at an external server
objectives: Design container networking for large fleets

subtopics: Block, file and object storage choices
days.lab_task: Deploy Rook Ceph, benchmark block and file storage with fio, run a database on it, and test recovery from a failed storage node.
days.deliverable: Storage design, benchmark results and the recovery test
checks: Run fio on block and file storage
IOPS and latency recorded for each
Database keeps running and data stays consistent

days.topic: Compliance and Audit for Container Platforms
subtopics: CIS benchmarks for Docker and Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Map 15 controls to container platform evidence, automate evidence collection, and run a mock audit answering five auditor requests from the evidence store.
days.deliverable: Control mapping, evidence automation and the mock audit record
checks: Answer an auditor request for image provenance
Evidence is produced from the store within minutes
Owner, reason and expiry are recorded

subtopics: Cost drivers: compute, storage, network, registry
days.lab_task: Cut container platform cost by at least 30% across compute, registry and build costs while meeting SLOs, and publish showback per team.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis, changes made, SLO evidence and showback report
checks: At least 30% lower or the gap is explained
Cost per team reconciles with the total
objectives: Find and reduce container platform costs

days.lab_task: Produce a modernisation roadmap for a portfolio of 40 legacy applications using containers, with a strangler fig plan for one core system and a value case.
days.deliverable: Roadmap, strangler fig plan and value case
checks: Applications are grouped and sequenced with dependencies
Each step can be rolled back
objectives: Justify modernisation with a value case

days.topic: Running AI and GPU Workloads in Containers
subtopics: GPU drivers and the container toolkit
Model files: in image or mounted
days.lab_task: Containerise a model with Triton Inference Server on a GPU host, compare model-in-image and mounted-model approaches, and measure throughput and GPU use.
days.deliverable: Dockerfiles, serving configuration and a performance comparison
checks: Compare the two model packaging approaches
Image size, start-up and update effort recorded

days.lab_task: For a provided company scenario, choose orchestrator, runtimes, registry and security architecture, write four architecture decision records, and present them.
days.deliverable: Four decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Options, criteria and the chosen option with reasons
Participant defends it with cost and risk evidence
Check consistency across the four records

subtopics: Disk exhaustion from images and logs
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix seven host-level container failures injected by the trainer, including disk exhaustion, a stuck container and a leaked network namespace.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis log with symptom, evidence, root cause and fix for each
checks: Removed after finding the held resource

days.lab_task: Assess a provided organisation's container maturity, write a 12-month platform roadmap with governance rules and adoption metrics, and present it to a mock leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, roadmap and leadership presentation
checks: Each area has evidence and a level
Items have outcomes, owners and metrics
Participant answers budget and risk questions with evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Container Platform Design
days.lab_task: Design and prototype an enterprise container platform for a regulated client covering runtimes, networking, storage, supply chain, build platform, reliability and cost, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working prototype, security and reliability test evidence, cost model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Unsigned, unscanned or privileged workloads are blocked
Platform SLOs met during registry and node failures
Monthly cost is broken down and justified
objectives: Design an enterprise container platform end to end
Prove security, reliability and cost with evidence
Defend the design to a review board
